item.title: Debate erupts over Florida's 'election integrity' bill
item.description: The Florida House passed what supporters are calling this year's "election integrity" bill, but critics continue to question whether the legislation will do more harm than good.

item.title: Lightning coach to miss 2 games after father's death
item.description: The Tampa Bay Lightning's head coach will be missing a few games this week.

item.title: WATCH: Injured manatee, calf heading to ZooTampa after rescue from Florida river
item.description: Two manatees are heading to a zoo in Tampa after crews rescued them from a Florida river.

item.title: USF Sarasota-Manatee students, faculty speak against proposed merger with New College
item.description: About 400 University of South Florida Sarasota-Manatee students, faculty, and alumni gathered in the student union Wednesday for a roundtable discussion about the proposed merger between the satellite campus and New College of Florida.

item.title: Tampa police see 'historic lows in crime across city,' per annual report
item.description: The annual report details a 20.8% decrease in robberies, 52.8% decrease in homicides, and a 21.3% decrease in total crime.

item.title: Florida's Alligator Alley shut down due to smoke from 24,000-acre wildfire
item.description: A large wildfire burning in the western Everglades has created smokey conditions, prompting officials to close down a stretch of Interstate 75 known as Alligator Alley.

item.title: Florida House passes bill to get rid of yellow license plate registration stickers
item.description: The Florida House passed a bill Wednesday that would do away with the yellow registration stickers on license plates.

item.title: 4 killed, 6 hurt in confrontation between Florida-registered boat, Cuban troops, gov. says
item.description: Four people are dead and six people are injured after a violent confrontation with Cuban border guards, according to the Cuban government.

item.title: Tampa man witnesses cartel retaliation violence while vacationing in Puerto Vallarta
item.description: A quick getaway turned dangerous for a Tampa Bay man vacationing in western Mexico after cartel-related violence erupted across parts of the state of Jalisco.
